props.gloss_en: Yosei ben Yoezer of Tzereida and Yosei ben Yochanan of Jerusalem decreed impurity on the land of the nations and on glass vessels
a hundred and eighty years before the House was destroyed the wicked kingdom spread over Israel
eighty years before the House was destroyed they decreed impurity on the land of the nations and on glass vessels
forty years before the House was destroyed the Sanhedrin was exiled and sat in the shops
R' Yitzchak bar Avdimi (as first transmitted): [the forty-years clause is] to say that they did not judge fines cases
rather say [he said]: that they did not judge capital cases
(entertained) the two Yoseis were also there in the eighty years
Hillel and Shimon, Gamliel and Shimon led their Nesiut before the House a hundred years
whereas Yosei ben Yoezer of Tzereida and Yosei ben Yochanan were much earlier
answer 1: they [the two Yoseis] decreed on the clod to burn
(answers 1, 2 and 3) and on the air [of the land of the nations] they [the two Yoseis] decreed nothing
(answers 1, 2 and 3) the Rabbis of the eighty years decreed on the air to suspend
(answers 2 and 3) they [the two Yoseis] decreed on the clod to suspend
answer 2: the Rabbis of the eighty years decreed on the clod to burn
answer 3: the Rabbis of the eighty years decreed on both [clod and air] to suspend
answer 3: and they came in Usha and decreed on the clod to burn
answer 3: and the air -- as it stood, it stands [Usha added nothing]
Ilfa: hands -- the beginning of their decree was for burning

for six doubts one burns the teruma -- a doubtful beit haperas, doubtful earth from the land of the nations, doubtful garments of an am haaretz, doubtful found vessels, doubtful spittle, doubtful human urine beside animal urine: for their certain contact and their doubtful impurity one burns the teruma
R' Yosei: even for their doubtful contact in a private domain one burns
the Sages: [doubtful contact] in a private domain -- one suspends
the Sages: [doubtful contact] in a public domain -- they are pure
Ulla: these six doubts -- they instituted them in Usha

objections.gloss_en: והא רבנן דשמנים שנה גזור! דאמר רב כהנא ... כך אמר אבא: שמנים שנה עד שלא חרב הבית גזרו טומאה על ארץ העמים -- the Rabbis of the eighty years decreed it, not the two Yoseis (kind svara under protest: an amoraic report has no ObjectionKind). Answers 1 (15b.1) and 2 (15b.3) were offered and fell; answer 3 stands

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא: the decree came in stages -- the two Yoseis decreed on the clod to suspend and on the air nothing; the Rabbis of the eighty years decreed on both to suspend; in Usha they decreed on the clod to burn, and the air stayed as it was (= p_zugot_gusha_tolin, p_zugot_avir_lo_klum, p_shmonim_gusha_tolin, p_shmonim_avir_tolin, p_usha_gusha_srefa, p_usha_avir_kedkai_kai)

objections.gloss_en: דיני קנסות סלקא דעתך? -- could it enter your mind [that it was fines they ceased to judge]? Rather say: capital cases

והתניא: הלל ושמעון גמליאל ושמעון נהגו נשיאותן לפני הבית מאה שנה, ואילו יוסי בן יועזר ... ויוסי בן יוחנן הוו קדמי טובא -- four generations of Nesiim span a hundred years before the destruction, and the two Yoseis were much earlier than they (= p_zugot_kadmei_tuva)

למימרא דחדא גזירתא הוה לשריפה? והאמר אילפא: ידים תחלת גזירתן לשריפה -- ידים הוא דתחלת גזירתן לשריפה, הא מידי אחרינא לא: only hands were decreed for burning from the start, so the clod's first decree was not burning (kind svara under protest: והאמר)

ואכתי באושא גזור! דתנן: על ששה ספקות שורפין את התרומה ... ועל ספק עפר הבא מארץ העמים ... ואמר עולא: אלו ששה ספיקות באושא התקינו (= p_ulla_shisha_sfekot_usha) -- burning for clod-contact was decreed in Usha, not by the Rabbis of the eighty years
